excluded.arenaActivate: Not routed by backend-local: Arena is a hosted screeps.com game mode with its own rooms, seasons and activation codes.
excluded.arenaFindInitRoom: Not routed by backend-local: Arena is a hosted screeps.com game mode; a private world has no Arena room to assign.
excluded.arenaOrderOffer: Not routed by backend-local: Arena is a hosted screeps.com game mode, and the offer is a Steam key sold by screeps.com.
excluded.arenaOrderPurchase: Not routed by backend-local: Arena is a hosted screeps.com game mode, and buying access is a screeps.com payment flow.
excluded.arenaStatus: Not routed by backend-local: Arena is a hosted screeps.com game mode; a private world has no Arena participation status.
excluded.arenaStatusUpdate: Not routed by backend-local: Arena is a hosted screeps.com game mode; a private world has no Arena activation or respawn state.
excluded.platformServersLike: Not routed by backend-local: likes belong to the screeps.com-curated community server directory, of which a private server is an entry.
excluded.platformServersUnlike: Not routed by backend-local: likes belong to the screeps.com-curated community server directory, of which a private server is an entry.
excluded.replaysAdd: Not routed by backend-local: the hosted screeps.com replay sharing service stores offline Survival simulations.
excluded.replaysHistoryShare: Not routed by backend-local: history share links (`screeps.com/s/<code>`) are resolved by screeps.com, and the official client resolves them only on official servers.
excluded.replaysHistoryShareChunk: Not routed by backend-local: the official client requests it only when `options.official` is true and a share code is present; otherwise it reads `/room-history?room=&time=` (the `platformRoomHistory` addition).
excluded.replaysList: Not routed by backend-local: the hosted screeps.com replay sharing service; a private world stores no uploaded replays.
excluded.seasonsAccessGrant: Not routed by backend-local: granting Seasonal World access consumes screeps.com Access Keys.
excluded.seasonsAccessGranted: Not routed by backend-local: Seasonal World access is a hosted screeps.com competition gated by Access Keys.
excluded.seasonsCurrentLastPost: Not routed by backend-local: the Season Chronicle is editorial content of the hosted Seasonal World.
excluded.seasonsUserRanks: Not routed by backend-local: final ranks of hosted Seasonal World competitions.

excluded.storeSteamPullResources: Not routed by backend-local: it moves Steam items into hosted screeps.com account resources.
excluded.storeSteamPushDecorations: Not routed by backend-local: it moves hosted screeps.com decorations into the Steam inventory.
excluded.storeSteamPushResources: Not routed by backend-local: it moves hosted screeps.com account resources into the Steam inventory.

excluded.storeXsollaCatalog: Not routed by backend-local: Xsolla item-shop catalog of screeps.com packages (payments); the stock server sells nothing.

excluded.storeXsollaToken: Not routed by backend-local: it opens an Xsolla payment session for screeps.com purchases (payments).
excluded.storeXsollaUser: Not routed by backend-local: it reads the screeps.com Xsolla CPU subscription (payments).
